001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text;
002
003import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * The Texts of a series of the translation.
010 */
011public interface TextList {
012
013  /**
014   * Getting the text that use specify locale
015   *
016   * @param locale The minecraft locale code (like en_us)
017   *
018   * @return The text
019   */
020  @NotNull
021  List<Component> forLocale(@NotNull String locale);
022
023  /**
024   * Getting the text for player locale
025   *
026   * @return Getting the text for player locale
027   */
028  @NotNull
029  List<Component> forLocale();
030
031  /**
032   * Getting this text is exists in the translation file
033   *
034   * @return true if this text is exists in the translation file
035   */
036  boolean isPresent();
037
038
039  /**
040   * Send text to the player
041   */
042  void send();
043}
